headline.title: 美债10年期收益率升破5%，油价续涨：市场综述
headline.summary: 美国10年期国债收益率升破5%，油价延续涨势，能源成本上行推升通胀担忧，并强化了市场对美联储加息的押注。亚洲债券跟随美债走低，印度国债因央行售债计划与全球抛售进一步承压。与此同时，AI板块反弹在一定程度上抵消了油价、利率和债市带来的压力，亚洲股市表现趋稳。
headline.title_en: Treasury 10-Year Yield Rises Past 5%, Oil Advances: Markets Wrap
headline.summary_en: Treasury yields climbed past 5% as rising energy costs stoked inflation concerns and strengthened bets on a Federal Reserve rate hike. Asian bonds followed Treasuries lower, with Indian debt hit especially hard by the central bank's plan to sell sovereign notes into an already pressured market. A rebound in AI-related shares helped offset pressure from oil, rates and the bond market, leaving Asian equities broadly steady.

headline.reason_en: It ties together three of the day's main threads — global rates, energy prices and equity sentiment — making it the widest-reaching market signal of the day, and it carries the highest score among finance candidates, making it the natural lead for the daily briefing.
